suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Phân tích Tài chính & Kinh doanh
suggestions.reasoning: As noted by WEF (2023), Business Intelligence and Data Analysts are among the fastest growing roles globally. While routine bookkeeping and data entry face high automation risk (OpenAI / UPenn, 2023), transitioning to business analysis leverages the candidate's deep domain knowledge in accounting and combines it with augmented data tools, leading to 43% faster market modeling and higher forecast accuracy (Stanford HAI, 2024).
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 6 years of general accounting experience from National Economics University and strong compliance skills give you an exceptional foundation in financial statements. Although you currently lack data analytics skills and data presentation abilities, your interests in financial analysis and digital tools make this an ideal adjacent pivot that builds directly upon your meticulous nature.
skillsGap: Executive data storytelling and metric presentation
